reason: Bending the metal stock seems like a practical first step toward a frame for the sitting and working area.
expectation: I expect the brake to form the stock into some kind of furniture frame, though its exact use is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric might make a cushion, but I want to build the supporting structure first.

effect: The brake produced frame sections, giving me a structure to build on.
reaction: That result was straightforward and unsurprising.
reason: The paving blocks may make a solid surface for the frame, bringing the work area closer to completion.
expectation: I expect the blocks to fit into the frame as a tabletop or other support, though I am unsure of the exact result.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could make a cushion, but I want to see what the frame and blocks make first.

effect: The blocks became feet for a window bench with a seat and worktop, rather than the surface I expected.
reaction: The ceramic feet were a small surprise, and making use of the level floor is satisfying.
reason: Combining the felt and fabric is the only available gameplay action and may provide padding for the bare bench.
expectation: I expect the materials to make a cushion or covering, though I don't know exactly how it will be used.

effect: The felt and fabric made a cushion for the window seat, as expected.
reason: The cushion naturally belongs on the bare bench, and this is the only available gameplay action.
expectation: I expect a cushioned window bench that provides a place to sit and work.

effect: The cushion completed the bench, providing both a worktop and a place to sit by the window.
reaction: The image of watching the sunset from the padded seat gave the practical build a pleasant personal payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the bare window bench was most worthwhile: the ceramic blocks became feet, and the earlier workshop floor now supports a level seat and worktop.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and fitting the cushion were straightforward, predictable steps with little decision-making.

surprise.text: I expected the paving blocks to form a surface, so their use as feet surprised me.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the exact role of the ceramic blocks was unclear before I combined them with the frame.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, mainly to see how the expedition and its return develop. This chapter's cozy payoff was appealing, though its combinations were mostly predictable.
